description: Settling a village apart (core src/editor/layout/settle.ts and pairing.ts; the Unreal plugin's BYOA B7 r4 - B8 r5 settle, characterised from its Portable code). The smallest change that parts what stands too close: each pair short of the gap its rule asks, and each body inside its clearance of an obstacle, pushed apart along the axis that separates them most, the lighter taking the larger share, repeated until nothing is short or nothing can move, every body within its own limit; shifts quantized to the millimetre. The neighbour rule (fitted buildings: the larger of two gaps, 0.25 m off other lots' paving, a limit that grows with the gap) on Brightwater Vale's ring of seven pack houses at 1, 4.5 and 6 m and on its real fits; the clearance rule (props out of each other and the walls, plant trunks off walls and paving, set-asides) on its props, whose positions and archetypes are the world's and whose sizes are nominal (the editor measures each bound asset); the pairing's seat sink; and the rules' tables. Plan frame: IR (x, z) metres.
